title: Fainting
text: Catch the fall safely and lay the person flat, raising the legs slightly.
Loosen tight clothing and let fresh air reach them; most fainting passes within a minute or two.
If they do not wake quickly, treat as unresponsive and get the crew medical officer.
After recovery, sit up slowly; check for injury from the fall and log the episode.

citations.source: American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED guidance: fainting care.
